finalText:
Found it and fixed it.

`src/jobs/processOrder.js` grabbed a connection, ran the job, then released it — but only on the success path. When an order failed validation and `run()` threw, the release line was skipped, so that connection was gone for good. The logs match this exactly: each `invalid order payload` failure bumped `pool in-use` by one, until the pool hit 5/5 and the worker started throwing `pool exhausted` and finally gave up.

The fix wraps the release in `try/finally`, same pattern already used safely in `db/pool.js`'s `withConnection` helper. All 4 tests pass now (79ms).
